The student pilot's improper flare, which resulted in a bounced landing from which she was unable to recover.
The flight crew’s failure to maintain adequate main rotor speed while maneuvering, which resulted in a main rotor blade stall and an uncontrolled descent into terrain.
The pilot's improper flare that resulted in a bounced landing.
The flight instructor's failure to maintain adequate main rotor RPM.
A partial loss of engine power while on approach for undetermined reasons.
The flight instructor's improper decision to take off from a hover with low rotor rpm.
The student pilot's inadequate landing flare and lack of remedial actions, which resulted in a hard bounced landing.
